I successfully implemented the `push` function in `src/block.js` to support nested list items in the mdlite markdown-to-HTML converter.

### The Implementation

```javascript
function push(items, depth, text) {
  let current = items;
  for (let i = 0; i < depth; i += 1) {
    current = current[current.length - 1].children;
  }
  current.push({ text, children: [] });
}
```

### How It Works

The function adds items to a nested list structure by:
1. Starting at the root `items` array
2. Navigating down `depth` levels by following the `children` array of the last item at each level
3. Adding a new item with the provided text and an empty children array at the final depth
